description: END-ACCEPT explicit scope terminator (ISO §2023:14.9.1) — introduced 2002. the current acceptStatement grammar (ACCEPT dataReference (FROM acceptSource)?) has no END_ACCEPT, so the binder gate (COBOL0816, folded to ConstructRegistry.Check in P2.6b) is presently UNREACHABLE — the matrix SKIPS its compile assertion until END-ACCEPT parsing lands and this row flips active with a real fixture. ACTIVATED by kb/Work PB134: the terminator finally parses, so the gate and the matrix assertions are live.
